<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₆H₁₅NO₂ (C₆H₁₅O₂N).</thought>
<final_answer>C6H15O2N</final_answer>
